title: Change handling: CDC, Change Tracking, CES, and event-driven patterns
summary: React to data changes with CDC, Change Tracking, Change Event Streaming, Azure Functions, and Logic Apps.

items: Compare CDC, Change Tracking, and CES.
Wire event-driven reactions with Azure Functions SQL trigger and Logic Apps.

blocks.body: Change handling underpins both integration and AI embedding maintenance (Domain 3) — know the options and trade-offs.

terms.definition: Captures full row change history to change tables.
Lightweight tracking of which rows changed (not full history).
Streams change events (Fabric) to downstream consumers.

blocks.body: **CDC** records full before/after history; **Change Tracking** is lighter and only says what changed; **CES** streams change events in Fabric. React with **Azure Functions (SQL trigger binding)** or **Logic Apps** for event-driven workflows. These same mechanisms keep embeddings current in Domain 3.

tips: CDC = full history (heavier); CT = which rows changed (lighter).
Azure Functions SQL trigger reacts to table changes.

blocks.body: Pick CDC for full history, CT for lightweight change detection, CES for Fabric streaming; automate reactions with Functions/Logic Apps.
